title: event_datagram Module
content_markdown: This is a module which provides a UNIX/UDP SOCKET transport layer implementation for the Event Interface.
overview: This is a module which provides a UNIX/UDP SOCKET transport layer implementation for the Event Interface.
how_it_works: The event payload is formated as a JSON-RPC notification, with the event name as the _method_ field and the event parameters as the _params_ field. There are two types of sockets used by this module, based on the sockets type. An UNIX socket should follow this syntax: _['unix:'] unix_socket_path_ An UDP socket should follow this syntax: _'udp:' address ':' port_
